column1: # Claims this repository makes about itself, each with the command that would refute it.
#   claim    the sentence a reader would believe
#   check    a shell command; its combined output is matched against `expect`
#   status   verified (the check is run) | unverified (listed as NEED, not run)
# A claim whose check fails is a claim the repository no longer supports. The point is not to
# replace the gates -- they check the product -- but to give the prose around them the same
# treatment: a sentence with a command behind it, and a NEED list for the sentences without one.

column2: the workspace has six packages, one of them the components crate
the runtime crate does not depend on metaform-vsa
the runtime crate does not depend on metaform-sme
the review scenario still ends decided, not insufficient
the probe's conflict report and its non-adoption are both visible
the probe's report is never adopted
the README points at the workspace binary, not a per-crate one
no crate keeps a stale build directory of its own
the paper is eleven pages
the charter exists in both languages and every top-level section has a counterpart
each of the charter's thirteen claims states its falsifier
the associative memory recalls 15 of 16 noisy probes at 128 pairs and 4096 bits
the relational criterion reports no pattern for bisimilar objects
the relational witness is a link to a green object
the SME evidence arithmetic reproduces SME4's 0.036 for a nine-parent entity
symmetric relations get a twin match with reversed arguments
unmapped entities become skolems in candidate inferences
a candidate without a held-out prediction is rejected when the request has unmeasured objects
a recorded refutation decides its premise and never enters the closure
the MCP server exposes ten tools and answers the host handshake transcript
two operand sets with one extension are reported as one candidate
a prediction that two competing rules agree on is refused
the coverage command reports missing cells, supported implications and blocking requirements
the secret scanner's self-test classifies every embedded sample correctly
only formal documents are tracked in this repository
no engine module imports a layer above it
the clause inducer proposes an extension that covers positives and excludes negatives
